intuition: The structure only needs the number of covered points, not the history of every interval insertion.

brute_force.approach: Store all inserted intervals and merge or enumerate them whenever a count is requested.
brute_force.time: add O(n log n), count O(n log n)

optimal.approach: Use a dynamic segment tree over the bounded integer domain; each node stores covered length and skips fully covered segments.
optimal.time: add O(log U) for the fixed coordinate domain in typical tree updates, count O(1)

edge_cases: Adding a fully covered range does not change the total.
Inclusive interval endpoints contribute right - left + 1 points.
